author: Puckfiend94
body: Yes.. Juan is the owner. He worked at the Laguna Hills location in the 80s. My mom worked there for a while. I'm in Vegas now and I miss that place. Used to go every Wednesday for the wet burrito combo daily special. Love their chicken burritos and huevos rancheros also.
